scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Define watermark placement and window state
cases.input_contract: Apply with Watermark(event_time,5minutes) before grouping by a 5-minute window and team. Aggregate records and total amount, retaining the window struct in the result.
cases.expected: A streaming aggregate with window, team, records, total. The watermark is attached to the same event-time column used by the window.
cases.verification: Assert streaming status and the four output fields before starting the first phase.

cases.title: Record actual watermark progress after the first phase
cases.input_contract: Run phase 1 and extract nonmissing watermark strings from retained progress. Parse them as instants rather than wall-clock elapsed duration.
cases.expected: Exactly 2 input rows processed. At least one watermark observation exists;the final observed watermark is no later than 00:00 for this phase.
cases.verification: Assert input count 2 and actual watermark presence/order;do not infer finalization from the file count alone.

cases.title: Accept a retained out-of-order event and observe finalization
cases.input_contract: Publish phase 2, run the compatible query again and read finalized sink rows as(start, team, records, total). Verify the 00:03 event contributed before the first window closed.
cases.expected: The finalized sink contains only(00:00, A,3,35) at this point. The actual watermark reaches at least 00:07.
cases.verification: Assert the exact first-window tuple and the observed progress boundary.

cases.title: Observe a far-late drop after the window has closed
cases.input_contract: Publish phase 3 after phase 2 has terminated. Read the actual state-operator dropped-by-watermark counters and verify the 999 event does not change the finalized first window.
cases.expected: Two new source rows consumed, one observed watermark drop and unchanged first-window result 35. B at 00:13 remains in pending state.
cases.verification: Assert input 2, drop counter 1 and the unchanged sink tuple. Preserve missing metric evidence as an error rather than guessing zero.

cases.title: Advance event time and distinguish finalized frompending output
cases.input_contract: Publish the 00:30 administrative advancer, run phase 4 and return a ledger of total source inputs, observed drops and final business-window records.
cases.expected: Seven total inputs, one observed drop, five finalized business records across three tuples:(00:00, A,3,35),(00:10, A,1,30),(00:10, B,1,7). The advancer window remains pending.
cases.verification: Assert all final tuples, input/drop reconciliation and actual watermark at least 00:25.

cases.title: Verify output-mode and sink eligibility through explicit failures
cases.input_contract: Attempt two invalid configurations in separate owned paths:Update mode to Parquet, and Append mode for an unwatermarked team aggregate. Require analysis rejection and stop any unexpectedly created query in finally.
cases.expected: Both configurations raiseAnalysisException;no active query remains. The valid windowed append sink stays intact.
cases.verification: Assert each named analysis failure and the unchanged three-row valid sink after the checks.
